A fenced code delight

This page is mostly code, proving that fenced blocks stay literal and are never inline-parsed. The title below is code, not emphasis.

*not emphasis* inside a fence

Hard and soft breaks

A backslash followed by a newline forces a hard break: one line
still the same line, but on a new visual row.

A trailing double-space does the same: two spaces at the end.
Now we are on a fresh line.
